lines.1: 「Then I'll keep watch out here. Take your time warming up.」
lines.3: 「If we're supposed to stay together, let's bathe together.」
lines.4: 「...Did you eat a poisonous mushroom after all?」
lines.5: 「I'm perfectly normal. Come on, let's go.」
lines.8: 「And here's the punchline: we're keeping our swimsuits on.」
lines.10: 「Ahh... I can't believe this place has a hot spring this nice...」
lines.14: 「With your hair down, you almost look like a different person.」
lines.17: She shot a squirt of hot water at me with her hand.
lines.18: 「Bwah! Sorry... I'd just never seen you like that before.」
lines.23: 「The stars just reminded me of something. Back in middle school...」
lines.25: 「Do you remember what first got us talking?」
lines.27: 「Right. My horoscope said people born on my birthday are methodical and neat... but then someone born on the same day was a total slob.」
lines.28: 「I couldn't believe you started lecturing me about getting my act together as soon as we met. I should've lied about my birthday during introductions.」
lines.29: 「It was your fault for being a slob. I'd have told you off anyway, as messy as you were.」
lines.30: She shot another jet of water at me.
lines.32: I fired back the same way.
lines.33: But my shot fell short of Konoe!
lines.36: 「...The hot spring has put you in an awfully good mood.」
lines.38: 「Isn't it a little too hot to relax in?」
lines.39: 「Maybe it's too hot for a wimp like you.」
lines.41: 「People who say that always get out before I do.」
lines.42: 「Hah. Fine. Want to make it a contest?」
lines.45: 「Tsushima... Why don't you quit being stubborn and get out?」
lines.48: 「You look even less composed than I do.」
lines.49: 「No, no. You're definitely in worse shape.」
lines.50: 「You're trying to smile, but your face isn't cooperating.」
lines.53: 「If you apologize now... I'll forgive you.」
lines.56: 「But I refuse to lose to you.」
lines.59: This was bad. I'd hit my limit.
lines.61: This couldn't be good for the human body.
lines.62: ...Maybe I should be the one to give in.
lines.68: Her eyes had turned into symbols. Now that was an impressive expression.
lines.72: 「You're alone on a deserted island with a guy. Is passing out really a good idea?」
lines.73: The instant I finished, I took a defensive stance.
lines.74: 「What!? Usually that'd get a lightning-fast comeback!」
